BENILLA_QUEST_MAX_ITEMS = 6 -- reward/choice/required rows per section (ref MAX_NUM_ITEMS -- =10 / MAX_REQUIRED_ITEMS=6 — the SAME v1 halving the quest -- log's own reward cap uses, QuestLogFrame.xml's own comment) BENILLA_QUEST_MAX_TITLES = 10 -- greeting title buttons (active + available combined; ref -- MAX_NUM_QUESTS=32, halved-and-then-some, an existing v1 cap) BENILLA_QUEST_SCROLLCHILD_H = 700 -- the generous scroll-child budget, see header comment
-- The detail write-on (ref QuestFrame.lua:4-6): the reveal edge moves at CPS characters -- per second, fading over LENGTH characters; the objectives/rewards block fades in over -- QUESTINFO_FADE_IN seconds once the text has fully written. QUEST_DESCRIPTION_GRADIENT_LENGTH = 30 QUEST_DESCRIPTION_GRADIENT_CPS = 40 QUESTINFO_FADE_IN = 1
-- "Instant Quest Text" (ref UIOptionsFrame.lua:20 — uvar QUEST_FADING_DISABLE, checkbox -- default "0"). Pinned "1" by direction (2026-07-17): text lands whole, the greeting/ -- progress/reward fade-ins skip — and the quill still scratches ONCE, because that is -- what the ref's instant mode actually does (see the OnShow arm below): it jams the -- reveal edge past the text rather than skipping the write-on, so the first OnUpdate -- tick plays one WriteQuest before the gradient runs off. Instant is one scribble, not -- silence. The ref home for this uvar is the options window; it moves to a real options -- surface when we build one. QUEST_FADING_DISABLE = "1"
-- One quest-item row (kind = "choice"/"reward"/"required", 1-based `index`) — unchanged from -- before this pass; every panel's rows share it via `GetQuestItemInfo`. function BenillaQuestItem_Set(button, kind, index) local name, texture, count, quality, usable, itemId = GetQuestItemInfo(kind, index) button.kind = kind button.index = index button.itemId = itemId button.quality = quality button.icon:SetTexture(texture or BENILLA_FALLBACK_ICON) button.name:SetText(name or "...") if (count or 1) > 1 then button.count:SetText(count) else button.count:SetText("") end local r, g, b = 1, 1, 1 if quality and BenillaTooltip_QualityColor then r, g, b = BenillaTooltip_QualityColor(quality) end button.name:SetTextColor(r, g, b) button:Show() end
-- ── The shared panel scroll kit: wheel + arrows + the minimal visual scrollbar + the -- measured child resize (the quest log's own kit, generalized by NAME — a panel's bar is -- "<scroll>Bar", its child "<scroll>Child"; QuestLogFrame.xml's SyncBar comment covers the -- no-Slider/no-drag deferral). ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── BENILLA_QUEST_SCROLL_STEP = 20 BENILLA_QUEST_SCROLL_TRACK_H = 302 -- 334-tall scroll, minus the two 16px arrows BENILLA_QUEST_SCROLL_THUMB_H = 16 BENILLA_QUEST_CHILD_PAD = 20 -- parchment breathing room under the last element
function BenillaQuestScroll_Step(sf, delta) sf:SetVerticalScroll(sf:GetVerticalScroll() + delta) -- engine clamps to [0, range] BenillaQuestScroll_SyncBar(sf) end
-- WoW wheel convention: +1 per notch up, -1 down — up lifts the content. function BenillaQuestScroll_OnMouseWheel(frame, delta) BenillaQuestScroll_Step(frame, -delta * BENILLA_QUEST_SCROLL_STEP) end
-- The log's SyncBar, name-generalized: hide the whole bar when nothing overflows, dead-end -- the arrows, seat the thumb at the scroll fraction. function BenillaQuestScroll_SyncBar(sf) local n = sf:GetName() local bar = getglobal(n .. "Bar") if not bar then return end local value = sf:GetVerticalScroll() local range = sf:GetVerticalScrollRange() if range <= 0 then bar:Hide() return end bar:Show() if value > 0 then getglobal(n .. "BarUp"):Enable() else getglobal(n .. "BarUp"):Disable() end if value < range then getglobal(n .. "BarDown"):Enable() else getglobal(n .. "BarDown"):Disable() end local travel = BENILLA_QUEST_SCROLL_TRACK_H - BENILLA_QUEST_SCROLL_THUMB_H getglobal(n .. "BarThumb"):SetPoint( "TOPLEFT", getglobal(n .. "BarTrack"), "TOPLEFT", 0, -(value / range * travel)) end
-- A widget's resolved bottom edge for the resize sum — nil when it isn't contributing -- (hidden frame / blank FontString / not yet resolved this frame). local function BenillaQuest_WidgetBottom(w) if not w then return nil end if w.IsShown then if not w:IsShown() then return nil end elseif w.GetText then local t = w:GetText() if not t or t == "" then return nil end end return w:GetBottom() end
-- Size a panel's scroll child to its MEASURED content (the resolved bottom of the lowest -- visible widget + padding) instead of a fixed budget — a fixed 700 left a huge dead -- scrollable span under short quests (the director's jank report). Frame-late like the -- log's resize (rects resolve after Lua runs), so the panel OnUpdate below re-runs this -- until it stops changing — the log's own convergence pattern. function BenillaQuestPanel_Resize(scrollName, widgets) local sf = getglobal(scrollName) local child = getglobal(scrollName .. "Child") local top = child:GetTop() if not top then return end local bottom = nil for i = 1, table.getn(widgets) do local b = BenillaQuest_WidgetBottom(getglobal(widgets[i])) if b and (not bottom or b < bottom) then bottom = b end end local height = 1 if bottom then height = (top - bottom) + BENILLA_QUEST_CHILD_PAD end if height < 1 then height = 1 end -- Only a real change re-sizes (SetHeight/UpdateScrollChildRect invalidate layout — -- an every-frame write would fight the resolver). if math.abs(child:GetHeight() - height) >= 1 then child:SetHeight(height) sf:UpdateScrollChildRect() BenillaQuestScroll_SyncBar(sf) end end
-- Per-panel resize candidates: every element that can be the LOWEST visible thing. BENILLA_QUEST_PANEL_WIDGETS = { ["BenillaQuestGreetingScroll"] = (function() local t = { "BenillaQuestGreetingText", "BenillaQuestActiveHeader", "BenillaQuestAvailableHeader" } for i = 1, BENILLA_QUEST_MAX_TITLES do table.insert(t, "BenillaQuestTitleButton" .. i) end return t end)(), ["BenillaQuestDetailScroll"] = (function() local t = { "BenillaQuestDetailBody", "BenillaQuestDetailObjective", "BenillaQuestDetailRewardTitleText", "BenillaQuestDetailItemChooseText", "BenillaQuestDetailItemReceiveText" } for i = 1, BENILLA_QUEST_MAX_ITEMS do table.insert(t, "BenillaQuestDetailChoice" .. i) table.insert(t, "BenillaQuestDetailReward" .. i) end for i = 1, 3 do table.insert(t, "BenillaQuestDetailMoneyCoin" .. i) end return t end)(), ["BenillaQuestProgressScroll"] = { "BenillaQuestProgressBody", "BenillaQuestProgressRequiredText", "BenillaQuestProgressRequiredMoneyText", "BenillaQuestProgressMoneyCoin1", "BenillaQuestProgressMoneyCoin2", "BenillaQuestProgressMoneyCoin3" }, ["BenillaQuestRewardScroll"] = (function() local t = { "BenillaQuestRewardBody", "BenillaQuestRewardRewardTitleText", "BenillaQuestRewardItemChooseText", "BenillaQuestRewardItemReceiveText" } for i = 1, BENILLA_QUEST_MAX_ITEMS do table.insert(t, "BenillaQuestRewardChoice" .. i) table.insert(t, "BenillaQuestRewardReward" .. i) end for i = 1, 3 do table.insert(t, "BenillaQuestRewardMoneyCoin" .. i) end return t end)(), }
BENILLA_QUEST_PANEL_SCROLLS = { greeting = "BenillaQuestGreetingScroll", detail = "BenillaQuestDetailScroll", progress = "BenillaQuestProgressScroll", reward = "BenillaQuestRewardScroll", }
-- The convergence driver: while the window shows, keep re-measuring the ACTIVE panel -- (cheap — the resize itself no-ops once the sum stabilizes; the log's own OnUpdate idiom). function BenillaQuestFrame_OnUpdate() local frame = getglobal("BenillaQuestFrame") if not frame:IsVisible() or not frame.panel then return end local scroll = BENILLA_QUEST_PANEL_SCROLLS[frame.panel] if scroll then BenillaQuestPanel_Resize(scroll, BENILLA_QUEST_PANEL_WIDGETS[scroll]) end end
-- ── Greeting panel (ref QuestFrameGreetingPanel_OnShow, QuestFrame.lua:219-282) ────────────── function BenillaQuestTitleButton_OnClick(button) if button.isActive then SelectActiveQuest(button.titleIndex) else SelectAvailableQuest(button.titleIndex) end PlaySound("igQuestListSelect") -- ref QuestTitleButton_OnClick, QuestFrame.lua:303 end
function BenillaQuestGreetingPanel_OnShow() getglobal("BenillaQuestDetailPanel"):Hide() getglobal("BenillaQuestProgressPanel"):Hide() getglobal("BenillaQuestRewardPanel"):Hide()
local greetingText = getglobal("BenillaQuestGreetingText") greetingText:SetText(GetGreetingText() or "") local activeHeader = getglobal("BenillaQuestActiveHeader") local availableHeader = getglobal("BenillaQuestAvailableHeader") local hbreak = getglobal("BenillaQuestGreetingBreak") local numActive = math.min(GetNumActiveQuests(), BENILLA_QUEST_MAX_TITLES) local numAvailable = math.min(GetNumAvailableQuests(), BENILLA_QUEST_MAX_TITLES - numActive)
-- Current Quests + its title-button run (l.235-253). if numActive == 0 then activeHeader:SetText("") else activeHeader:SetText("Current Quests") activeHeader:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", greetingText, "BOTTOMLEFT", 0, -10) for i = 1, numActive do local button = getglobal("BenillaQuestTitleButton" .. i) button.isActive = true button.titleIndex = i button:SetText(GetActiveTitle(i)) button:Show() if i == 1 then button:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", activeHeader, "BOTTOMLEFT", -10, -5) else button:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", getglobal("BenillaQuestTitleButton" .. (i - 1)), "BOTTOMLEFT", 0, 0) end end end
-- The horizontal break + Available Quests + ITS title-button run (l.254-278) — the break -- shows only when BOTH lists are non-empty (l.256-260). if numActive > 0 and numAvailable > 0 then hbreak:SetTexture("Interface\\QuestFrame\\UI-HorizontalBreak") hbreak:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", getglobal("BenillaQuestTitleButton" .. numActive), "BOTTOMLEFT", 22, -10) else hbreak:SetTexture(nil) end if numAvailable == 0 then availableHeader:SetText("") else availableHeader:SetText("Available Quests") if numActive > 0 then availableHeader:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", hbreak, "BOTTOMLEFT", -12, -10) else availableHeader:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", greetingText, "BOTTOMLEFT", 0, -10) end for i = numActive + 1, numActive + numAvailable do local button = getglobal("BenillaQuestTitleButton" .. i) button.isActive = false button.titleIndex = i - numActive button:SetText(GetAvailableTitle(i - numActive)) button:Show() if i == numActive + 1 then button:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", availableHeader, "BOTTOMLEFT", -10, -5) else button:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", getglobal("BenillaQuestTitleButton" .. (i - 1)), "BOTTOMLEFT", 0, 0) end end end for i = numActive + numAvailable + 1, BENILLA_QUEST_MAX_TITLES do getglobal("BenillaQuestTitleButton" .. i):Hide() end
getglobal("BenillaQuestGreetingScroll"):SetVerticalScroll(0) -- The action button inherits `hidden="true"` from `BenillaQuestPanelButtonTemplate` -- (a virtual template — never itself drawn — declared hidden so a bare `inherits=` alone -- doesn't imply "visible"); every panel must :Show() its own buttons explicitly, the same -- way BenillaQuestItem_Set already does for item/title rows. getglobal("BenillaQuestGreetingGoodbyeButton"):Show() if QUEST_FADING_DISABLE == "0" then -- ref l.223-226: instant text skips the fade-in UIFrameFadeIn(getglobal("BenillaQuestGreetingScrollChild"), QUESTINFO_FADE_IN) end end
function BenillaQuestGreetingGoodbyeButton_OnClick() -- ref l.749-752: no DeclineQuest() call here — the greeting has no in-progress panel to -- decline yet. The window's own OnHide (CloseQuest()) still ends the giver session. HideUIPanel(getglobal("BenillaQuestFrame")) end
-- ── The shared reward/choice grid (ref's `QuestFrameItems_Update`, QuestFrame.lua:311-522) — -- ported line-for-line, the SAME idiom `QuestLogFrame.xml`'s `BenillaQuestLogRewards_Update` -- already proved: 2-per-row, odd index starts a new row under the row two back, even index -- sits beside the previous. `prefix` is "BenillaQuestDetail" or "BenillaQuestReward" — both -- panels read the SAME giver getters (`GetNumQuestChoices`/`GetQuestItemInfo`/`GetRewardMoney` -- are giver-global, not panel-specific — `benilla-ui`'s `quest.rs`), only the widget names -- differ (the ref's own two panels are likewise fed by the one shared function). ────────────── function BenillaQuestItems_Update(prefix) local numChoices = GetNumQuestChoices() local numRewards = GetNumQuestRewards() local money = GetRewardMoney()
-- l.343-349: the "Rewards" header shows iff there's anything at all to show. local header = getglobal(prefix .. "RewardTitleText") local haveAnyReward = numChoices > 0 or numRewards > 0 or (money and money > 0) header:SetText(haveAnyReward and "Rewards" or "")
-- l.367-413: choosable rewards. local chooseText = getglobal(prefix .. "ItemChooseText") local lastChoice = math.min(numChoices, BENILLA_QUEST_MAX_ITEMS) chooseText:SetText(numChoices > 0 and "You may choose one of these rewards:" or "") for i = 1, BENILLA_QUEST_MAX_ITEMS do local choice = getglobal(prefix .. "Choice" .. i) if i <= lastChoice then BenillaQuestItem_Set(choice, "choice", i) if i == 1 then choice:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", chooseText, "BOTTOMLEFT", -3, -5) elseif i % 2 == 1 then choice:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", getglobal(prefix .. "Choice" .. (i - 2)), "BOTTOMLEFT", 0, -2) else choice:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", getglobal(prefix .. "Choice" .. (i - 1)), "TOPRIGHT", 1, 0) end else choice:Hide() end end
-- l.454-473: "You will receive:"/"You will also receive:" — shown for a fixed reward OR -- money, even with zero fixed-reward rows (money-only quest). local receiveText = getglobal(prefix .. "ItemReceiveText") local haveFixed = numRewards > 0 or (money and money > 0) if haveFixed then if numChoices > 0 then receiveText:SetText("You will also receive:") local anchorIndex = lastChoice if anchorIndex % 2 == 0 then anchorIndex = anchorIndex - 1 end receiveText:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", getglobal(prefix .. "Choice" .. anchorIndex), "BOTTOMLEFT", 3, -5) else receiveText:SetText("You will receive:") receiveText:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", header, "BOTTOMLEFT", 3, -5) end else receiveText:SetText("") end
-- l.474-513: fixed rewards, same 2-per-row pattern chained off ItemReceiveText. local lastReward = math.min(numRewards, BENILLA_QUEST_MAX_ITEMS) for i = 1, BENILLA_QUEST_MAX_ITEMS do local reward = getglobal(prefix .. "Reward" .. i) if i <= lastReward then BenillaQuestItem_Set(reward, "reward", i) if i == 1 then reward:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", receiveText, "BOTTOMLEFT", -3, -5) elseif i % 2 == 1 then reward:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", getglobal(prefix .. "Reward" .. (i - 2)), "BOTTOMLEFT", 0, -2) else reward:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", getglobal(prefix .. "Reward" .. (i - 1)), "TOPRIGHT", 1, 0) end else reward:Hide() end end
if money and money > 0 then BenillaMoney_Set(prefix .. "Money", money, true) else BenillaMoney_Clear(prefix .. "Money") end end
-- ── Detail panel (ref QuestFrameDetailPanel_OnShow, QuestFrame.lua:524-552) ────────────────── function BenillaQuestDetailPanel_OnShow() getglobal("BenillaQuestGreetingPanel"):Hide() getglobal("BenillaQuestProgressPanel"):Hide() getglobal("BenillaQuestRewardPanel"):Hide()
getglobal("BenillaQuestDetailTitle"):SetText(GetTitleText() or "") getglobal("BenillaQuestDetailBody"):SetText(GetQuestText() or "") getglobal("BenillaQuestDetailObjectiveHeader"):SetText("Quest Objectives") getglobal("BenillaQuestDetailObjective"):SetText(GetObjectiveText() or "") BenillaQuestItems_Update("BenillaQuestDetail") getglobal("BenillaQuestDetailScroll"):SetVerticalScroll(0) getglobal("BenillaQuestAcceptButton"):Show() getglobal("BenillaQuestDeclineButton"):Show()
-- Arm the write-on (ref l.538-551): objectives/rewards invisible and Accept dead -- until the description has finished writing itself onto the parchment. getglobal("BenillaQuestDetailTextAlphaFrame"):SetAlpha(0) getglobal("BenillaQuestAcceptButton"):Disable() local panel = getglobal("BenillaQuestDetailPanel") panel.fading = 1 panel.fadingProgress = 0 getglobal("BenillaQuestDetailBody"):SetAlphaGradient(0, QUEST_DESCRIPTION_GRADIENT_LENGTH) -- Instant text (ref l.549-551): the write-on still arms, but the reveal edge starts -- past any quest text's end — the first OnUpdate tick scratches the quill once, runs -- the gradient off, and wakes everything on the spot. if QUEST_FADING_DISABLE == "1" then panel.fadingProgress = 1024 end end
-- ref QuestFrameDetailPanel_OnUpdate (QuestFrame.lua:555-570): advance the reveal edge, -- scratching the WriteQuest quill each tick — the kit's no-duplicates flag (0x20) keeps -- the per-frame PlaySound from stacking (a new scribble only starts when the previous -- wav ends, which IS the continuous writing sound). When the gradient runs off the end -- of the text, fade the objectives/rewards block in (or snap it on, instant mode) and -- wake the Accept button. With instant text the arm above started the edge at 1024, so -- all of this happens on the first tick: one scratch, then the wake. function BenillaQuestDetailPanel_OnUpdate(panel, elapsed) if panel.fading then panel.fadingProgress = panel.fadingProgress + (elapsed * QUEST_DESCRIPTION_GRADIENT_CPS) PlaySound("WriteQuest") if not getglobal("BenillaQuestDetailBody"):SetAlphaGradient(panel.fadingProgress, QUEST_DESCRIPTION_GRADIENT_LENGTH) then panel.fading = nil if QUEST_FADING_DISABLE == "0" then UIFrameFadeIn(getglobal("BenillaQuestDetailTextAlphaFrame"), QUESTINFO_FADE_IN) else -- instant: the block snaps on, no fade (ref l.561-564) getglobal("BenillaQuestDetailTextAlphaFrame"):SetAlpha(1) end getglobal("BenillaQuestAcceptButton"):Enable() end end end
function BenillaQuestDetailAcceptButton_OnClick() AcceptQuest() end
function BenillaQuestDetailDeclineButton_OnClick() -- vanilla's client-side decline sends no packet; hide immediately (no one-frame lag, -- the same convention every NPC window's close button already uses — e.g. -- BenillaMerchantCloseButton_OnClick). DeclineQuest() PlaySound("igQuestCancel") -- ref QuestDetailDeclineButton_OnClick, QuestFrame.lua:577 HideUIPanel(getglobal("BenillaQuestFrame")) end
-- ── Progress panel (ref QuestFrameProgressPanel_OnShow/Items_Update, QuestFrame.lua:143-217) -- ITS OWN grid — NOT the choose/reward one above: item1 is the only Lua-repositioned row (below -- the required-money line when money is required, else below the header directly, l.186-192); -- items 2-6 are a STATIC XML 2-column×3-row chain off item1/item3/item5 (ref l.416-460) that -- the resolver's fixpoint keeps correctly re-propagated as item1 moves — no Lua needed for -- them at all. ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── function BenillaQuestProgressPanel_OnShow() getglobal("BenillaQuestGreetingPanel"):Hide() getglobal("BenillaQuestDetailPanel"):Hide() getglobal("BenillaQuestRewardPanel"):Hide()
getglobal("BenillaQuestProgressTitle"):SetText(GetTitleText() or "") getglobal("BenillaQuestProgressBody"):SetText(GetProgressText() or "")
local numItems = math.min(GetNumQuestItems(), BENILLA_QUEST_MAX_ITEMS) local money = GetQuestMoneyToGet() local reqText = getglobal("BenillaQuestProgressRequiredText") local moneyText = getglobal("BenillaQuestProgressRequiredMoneyText") local item1 = getglobal("BenillaQuestProgressRequired1") if numItems > 0 or (money and money > 0) then reqText:SetText("Items Needed:") if money and money > 0 then moneyText:SetText("Required Money:") BenillaMoney_Set("BenillaQuestProgressMoney", money, true) item1:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", moneyText, "BOTTOMLEFT", 0, -10) else moneyText:SetText("") BenillaMoney_Clear("BenillaQuestProgressMoney") item1:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", reqText, "BOTTOMLEFT", -3, -5) end else reqText:SetText("") moneyText:SetText("") BenillaMoney_Clear("BenillaQuestProgressMoney") end for i = 1, BENILLA_QUEST_MAX_ITEMS do if i <= numItems then BenillaQuestItem_Set(getglobal("BenillaQuestProgressRequired" .. i), "required", i) else getglobal("BenillaQuestProgressRequired" .. i):Hide() end end
local continueButton = getglobal("BenillaQuestProgressContinueButton") if IsQuestCompletable() then continueButton:Enable() else continueButton:Disable() end continueButton:Show() getglobal("BenillaQuestProgressGoodbyeButton"):Show() getglobal("BenillaQuestProgressScroll"):SetVerticalScroll(0) if QUEST_FADING_DISABLE == "0" then -- ref l.159-162: instant text skips the fade-in UIFrameFadeIn(getglobal("BenillaQuestProgressScrollChild"), QUESTINFO_FADE_IN) end end
function BenillaQuestProgressContinueButton_OnClick() CompleteQuest() -- the progress panel's "Continue" — requests the reward offer end
function BenillaQuestProgressGoodbyeButton_OnClick() DeclineQuest() PlaySound("igQuestCancel") -- ref QuestGoodbyeButton_OnClick, QuestFrame.lua:112 HideUIPanel(getglobal("BenillaQuestFrame")) end
-- ── Reward panel (ref QuestFrameRewardPanel_OnShow + reward-item clicks, QuestFrame.lua:72-141) function BenillaQuestRewardPanel_OnShow() getglobal("BenillaQuestGreetingPanel"):Hide() getglobal("BenillaQuestDetailPanel"):Hide() getglobal("BenillaQuestProgressPanel"):Hide()
getglobal("BenillaQuestRewardTitle"):SetText(GetTitleText() or "") getglobal("BenillaQuestRewardBody"):SetText(GetRewardText() or "") getglobal("BenillaQuestFrame").itemChoice = 0 getglobal("BenillaQuestRewardChoiceHighlight"):Hide() BenillaQuestItems_Update("BenillaQuestReward") getglobal("BenillaQuestRewardScroll"):SetVerticalScroll(0) getglobal("BenillaQuestRewardCompleteButton"):Show() getglobal("BenillaQuestRewardCancelButton"):Show() -- ref l.85-88: the whole parchment content fades in — unless the text is instant. if QUEST_FADING_DISABLE == "0" then getglobal("BenillaQuestRewardScrollChild"):SetAlpha(0) UIFrameFadeIn(getglobal("BenillaQuestRewardScrollChild"), QUESTINFO_FADE_IN) end end
-- ref QuestRewardItem_OnClick (l.127-141): only a REWARD-panel choice row is selectable (the -- detail panel's rows, and both panels' FIXED reward rows, are informational only — no -- OnClick wired to them, matching the ref's separate QuestRewardItemTemplate vs QuestItemTemplate). function BenillaQuestRewardChoice_OnClick(button) getglobal("BenillaQuestFrame").itemChoice = button.index -- Ref QuestRewardItem_OnClick l.137-138 verbatim: the glow frame seats at (-8,7) on -- the clicked row's TOPLEFT. local hl = getglobal("BenillaQuestRewardChoiceHighlight") hl:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", button, "TOPLEFT", -8, 7) hl:Show() end
function BenillaQuestRewardCompleteButton_OnClick() local choice = getglobal("BenillaQuestFrame").itemChoice or 0 if GetNumQuestChoices() > 0 and choice == 0 then return end -- must pick a choice first GetQuestReward(math.max(choice - 1, 0)) -- 1-based row -> 0-based wire index PlaySound("igQuestListComplete") -- ref QuestRewardCompleteButton_OnClick, QuestFrame.lua:101 end
function BenillaQuestRewardCancelButton_OnClick() DeclineQuest() PlaySound("igQuestCancel") -- ref QuestRewardCancelButton_OnClick, QuestFrame.lua:93 HideUIPanel(getglobal("BenillaQuestFrame")) end
-- ── Window lifecycle (ref QuestFrame_OnLoad/OnEvent, QuestFrame.lua:8-70) ──────────────────── function BenillaQuestFrame_OnLoad(frame) -- The NPC portrait: the "npc" unit token → the questgiver's live model bake -- (crates/benilla/src/portrait, InteractNpc) — the same binding MerchantFrame/GossipFrame use. SetPortraitTexture(getglobal(frame:GetName() .. "Portrait"), "npc") frame:RegisterEvent("QUEST_GREETING") frame:RegisterEvent("QUEST_DETAIL") frame:RegisterEvent("QUEST_PROGRESS") frame:RegisterEvent("QUEST_COMPLETE") frame:RegisterEvent("QUEST_ITEM_UPDATE") frame:RegisterEvent("QUEST_FINISHED") frame.itemChoice = 0 frame.panel = nil end
-- Re-run whichever panel is currently live (QUEST_ITEM_UPDATE — an in-place row refresh, e.g. -- an item name landing async; ref l.45-58 calls the item-grid function directly rather than -- re-showing the panel — re-running the panel's own OnShow here is equivalent AND simpler: it -- reads the same live QuestState, so title/body come out unchanged and only the rows actually -- differ). function BenillaQuestFrame_Repaint(panel) if panel == "greeting" then BenillaQuestGreetingPanel_OnShow() elseif panel == "detail" then BenillaQuestDetailPanel_OnShow() elseif panel == "progress" then BenillaQuestProgressPanel_OnShow() elseif panel == "reward" then BenillaQuestRewardPanel_OnShow() end end
function BenillaQuestFrame_OnEvent(frame) if event == "QUEST_FINISHED" then HideUIPanel(frame) frame.panel = nil return end if event == "QUEST_ITEM_UPDATE" then -- The in-place refresh also carries the NPC name (arg1) — in live play the ask-once -- name often lands one frame AFTER the panel opened, arriving exactly here; dropping -- it left the title bar blank (caught reviewing the ui-quest capture). if arg1 and arg1 ~= "" then getglobal("BenillaQuestNpcNameText"):SetText(arg1) end if frame:IsVisible() and frame.panel then BenillaQuestFrame_Repaint(frame.panel) end return end
getglobal("BenillaQuestNpcNameText"):SetText(arg1 or "") if event == "QUEST_GREETING" then frame.panel = "greeting" elseif event == "QUEST_DETAIL" then frame.panel = "detail" elseif event == "QUEST_PROGRESS" then frame.panel = "progress" elseif event == "QUEST_COMPLETE" then frame.panel = "reward" end
ShowUIPanel(frame) -- ref l.33-44: Hide() then Show() the target CHILD panel — forces its own OnShow to run -- (which hides the other three siblings + repaints itself), even on a same-panel refresh -- (e.g. re-QUERY_QUEST on the same NPC while Detail is already open). local names = { greeting = "BenillaQuestGreetingPanel", detail = "BenillaQuestDetailPanel", progress = "BenillaQuestProgressPanel", reward = "BenillaQuestRewardPanel", } local target = getglobal(names[frame.panel]) target:Hide() target:Show() end
function BenillaQuestCloseButton_OnClick() CloseQuest() HideUIPanel(getglobal("BenillaQuestFrame")) end
